title: A Restaurant Review
text:
Last week, Ana wrote a review of a new restaurant in her town. She said the food was very good. The pasta was hot and the salad was fresh. However, the service was slow.

Ana gave the restaurant four stars out of five. She wrote that she would return with her family. Her friend Tom read the review and decided to visit the restaurant on Friday.

questions.text: How many stars did Ana give the restaurant?
What did Tom decide to do?
Why did Ana still give the restaurant four stars?
options: Because the food was good and she liked it overall
Because the service was very fast

questions.text: What can we infer about Ana's review?
options: It was written by a chef

vocabulary.definition: a written opinion about a product, place or service
recently made or picked, not old
the help that staff give to customers

paragraph_translations: Na semana passada, Ana escreveu uma avaliação de um restaurante novo na cidade dela. Ela disse que a comida estava muito boa. A massa estava quente e a salada estava fresca. No entanto, o atendimento foi lento.
Ana deu ao restaurante quatro estrelas de cinco. Ela escreveu que voltaria com a família. O amigo dela, Tom, leu a avaliação e decidiu visitar o restaurante na sexta-feira.
